purpose: Validate the point-in-time calendar data contract and event-bundle layer before any new price experiment.
hypothesis: A fail-closed contract can accept licensed pre/post-release vintages, merge simultaneous components, attach official-document features, and reject the existing research calendar because its consensus vintage and rights are not proven.

expected_negative_control.source: Forex Factory research cache normalized with official BLS times
expected_negative_control.interpretation: Rejecting all rows is a successful leak-prevention test, not a failure to parse the file.

decision_rule.READY_FOR_LICENSED_VENDOR_INGESTION: All pipeline gates pass and the negative control is rejected exactly as registered.
decision_rule.FAIL_DATA_CONTRACT: Any invalid or unlicensed component becomes price-eligible, a revision overwrites a prior vintage, simultaneous releases split, hashes drift, or a registered count/test gate fails.

economic_decision: Even if the pipeline passes, the next price trial remains NO_GO until licensed authenticated point-in-time snapshots and retention/ML rights are supplied.
out_of_scope: using documentation examples as empirical data
